1	"""Flask API for task management.
2	
3	Storage is flat-file (JSON), not a database — see storage.py.
4	
5	Endpoints under /tasks require a valid JWT (see /auth/register and
6	/auth/login). Each user only sees and manages their own tasks.
7	"""
8	
9	import os
10	from datetime import datetime, timedelta
11	from functools import wraps
12	
13	import jwt
14	from flask import Flask, g, jsonify, request
15	from werkzeug.security import check_password_hash, generate_password_hash
16	
17	import storage
18	
19	JWT_ALGORITHM = "HS256"
20	JWT_EXP_HOURS = 24
21	
22	
23	def create_app():
24	    app = Flask(__name__)
25	    storage.init_storage()
26	
27	    app.config["JWT_SECRET_KEY"] = os.environ.get(
28	        "JWT_SECRET_KEY", "dev-secret-key-change-in-production-32bytes-min"
29	    )
30	
31	    def generate_token(user):
32	        payload = {
33	            "sub": str(user["id"]),
34	            "username": user["username"],
35	            "exp": datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(hours=JWT_EXP_HOURS),
36	        }
37	        return jwt.encode(payload, app.config["JWT_SECRET_KEY"], algorithm=JWT_ALGORITHM)
38	
39	    def require_auth(f):
40	        @wraps(f)
41	        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
42	            auth_header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
43	            if not auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
44	                return jsonify({"error": "Missing or invalid Authorization header"}), 401
45	
46	            token = auth_header[len("Bearer "):].strip()
47	            if not token:
48	                return jsonify({"error": "Missing or invalid Authorization header"}), 401
49	
50	            try:
51	                payload = jwt.decode(
52	                    token, app.config["JWT_SECRET_KEY"], algorithms=[JWT_ALGORITHM]
53	                )
54	            except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
55	                return jsonify({"error": "Token expired"}), 401
56	            except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
57	                return jsonify({"error": "Invalid token"}), 401
58	
59	            g.user_id = int(payload["sub"])
60	            g.username = payload.get("username")
61	            return f(*args, **kwargs)
62	
63	        return wrapper
64	
65	    @app.errorhandler(404)
66	    def not_found(_e):
67	        return jsonify({"error": "Not found"}), 404
68	
69	    @app.errorhandler(405)
70	    def method_not_allowed(_e):
71	        return jsonify({"error": "Method not allowed"}), 405
72	
73	    @app.route("/auth/register", methods=["POST"])
74	    def register():
75	        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
76	        username = data.get("username")
77	        password = data.get("password")
78	
79	        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username.strip():
80	            return jsonify({"error": "username is required"}), 400
81	        if not isinstance(password, str) or not password:
82	            return jsonify({"error": "password is required"}), 400
83	
84	        password_hash = generate_password_hash(password)
85	        user = storage.create_user(username.strip(), password_hash)
86	        if user is None:
87	            return jsonify({"error": "username already exists"}), 409
88	
89	        return jsonify({"id": user["id"], "username": user["username"]}), 201
90	
91	    @app.route("/auth/login", methods=["POST"])
92	    def login():
93	        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
94	        username = data.get("username")
95	        password = data.get("password")
96	
97	        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username.strip():
98	            return jsonify({"error": "username is required"}), 400
99	        if not isinstance(password, str) or not password:
100	            return jsonify({"error": "password is required"}), 400
101	
102	        user = storage.get_user_by_username(username.strip())
103	        if user is None or not check_password_hash(user["password_hash"], password):
104	            return jsonify({"error": "invalid username or password"}), 401
105	
106	        token = generate_token(user)
107	        return jsonify({"token": token}), 200
108	
109	    @app.route("/tasks", methods=["POST"])
110	    @require_auth
111	    def create_task():
112	        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
113	        title = data.get("title")
114	        if not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip():
115	            return jsonify({"error": "title is required"}), 400
116	        task = storage.create_task(title.strip(), g.user_id)
117	        return jsonify(task), 201
118	
119	    @app.route("/tasks", methods=["GET"])
120	    @require_auth
121	    def list_tasks():
122	        return jsonify(storage.list_tasks(g.user_id)), 200
123	
124	    @app.route("/tasks/<int:task_id>", methods=["GET"])
125	    @require_auth
126	    def get_task(task_id):
127	        task = storage.get_task(task_id)
128	        if task is None or task.get("owner_id") != g.user_id:
129	            return jsonify({"error": "Task not found"}), 404
130	        return jsonify(task), 200
131	
132	    @app.route("/tasks/<int:task_id>", methods=["PUT"])
133	    @require_auth
134	    def update_task(task_id):
135	        existing = storage.get_task(task_id)
136	        if existing is None or existing.get("owner_id") != g.user_id:
137	            return jsonify({"error": "Task not found"}), 404
138	
139	        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
140	        has_title = "title" in data
141	        has_status = "status" in data
142	        if not has_title and not has_status:
143	            return jsonify({"error": "title or status is required"}), 400
144	
145	        title = data.get("title")
146	        if has_title and (not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip()):
147	            return jsonify({"error": "title must be a non-empty string"}), 400
148	
149	        status = data.get("status")
150	        if has_status and (not isinstance(status, str) or not status.strip()):
151	            return jsonify({"error": "status must be a non-empty string"}), 400
152	
153	        task = storage.update_task(
154	            task_id,
155	            title=title.strip() if has_title else None,
156	            status=status.strip() if has_status else None,
157	        )
158	        return jsonify(task), 200
159	
160	    return app
161	
162	
163	app = create_app()
164	
165	if __name__ == "__main__":
166	    app.run(debug=True)

1	"""Flat-file (JSON) storage layer for tasks and users. No database engine is
2	used — all data lives in a single JSON file on disk, guarded by an
3	in-process lock plus atomic write-and-replace to avoid partial/corrupt
4	writes."""
5	
6	import json
7	import os
8	import threading
9	from datetime import datetime
10	
11	_lock = threading.Lock()
12	
13	DEFAULT_FILE = os.path.join(
14	    os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "data", "tasks.json"
15	)
16	
17	
18	def get_storage_file():
19	    return os.environ.get("TASKS_FILE", DEFAULT_FILE)
20	
21	
22	def init_storage():
23	    path = get_storage_file()
24	    directory = os.path.dirname(path)
25	    if directory:
26	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
27	    if not os.path.exists(path):
28	        _write({"next_id": 1, "tasks": [], "next_user_id": 1, "users": []})
29	        return
30	
31	    with _lock:
32	        data = _read()
33	        changed = False
34	        if "users" not in data:
35	            data["users"] = []
36	            changed = True
37	        if "next_user_id" not in data:
38	            data["next_user_id"] = 1
39	            changed = True
40	        for task in data.get("tasks", []):
41	            if "owner_id" not in task:
42	                task["owner_id"] = None
43	                changed = True
44	        if changed:
45	            _write(data)
46	
47	
48	def _read():
49	    path = get_storage_file()
50	    with open(path, "r") as f:
51	        return json.load(f)
52	
53	
54	def _write(data):
55	    path = get_storage_file()
56	    tmp_path = f"{path}.tmp"
57	    with open(tmp_path, "w") as f:
58	        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
59	    os.replace(tmp_path, path)
60	
61	
62	def create_task(title, owner_id):
63	    with _lock:
64	        data = _read()
65	        task = {
66	            "id": data["next_id"],
67	            "title": title,
68	            "status": "pending",
69	            "created_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
70	            "owner_id": owner_id,
71	        }
72	        data["tasks"].append(task)
73	        data["next_id"] += 1
74	        _write(data)
75	        return task
76	
77	
78	def list_tasks(owner_id):
79	    data = _read()
80	    tasks = [t for t in data["tasks"] if t.get("owner_id") == owner_id]
81	    return sorted(tasks, key=lambda t: (t["created_at"], t["id"]), reverse=True)
82	
83	
84	def get_task(task_id):
85	    data = _read()
86	    for task in data["tasks"]:
87	        if task["id"] == task_id:
88	            return task
89	    return None
90	
91	
92	def update_task(task_id, title=None, status=None):
93	    with _lock:
94	        data = _read()
95	        for task in data["tasks"]:
96	            if task["id"] == task_id:
97	                if title is not None:
98	                    task["title"] = title
99	                if status is not None:
100	                    task["status"] = status
101	                _write(data)
102	                return task
103	        return None
104	
105	
106	def create_user(username, password_hash):
107	    with _lock:
108	        data = _read()
109	        for user in data["users"]:
110	            if user["username"] == username:
111	                return None
112	        user = {
113	            "id": data["next_user_id"],
114	            "username": username,
115	            "password_hash": password_hash,
116	        }
117	        data["users"].append(user)
118	        data["next_user_id"] += 1
119	        _write(data)
120	        return user
121	
122	
123	def get_user_by_username(username):
124	    data = _read()
125	    for user in data["users"]:
126	        if user["username"] == username:
127	            return user
128	    return None
129	
130	
131	def get_user_by_id(user_id):
132	    data = _read()
133	    for user in data["users"]:
134	        if user["id"] == user_id:
135	            return user
136	    return None

def send_notification_email(user_email, task_title):

    async dispatch path can be exercised end-to-end without a mail provider.

    logger.info(message)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Completion notification trigger
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_status_change_to_completed_triggers_notification(auth_client):
    c, headers = auth_client
    created = create(c, headers, "task").get_json()
    with patch("app.send_notification_email") as mock_task:
        resp = c.put(
            f"/tasks/{created['id']}", json={"status": "completed"}, headers=headers
        )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    mock_task.delay.assert_called_once()
    email_arg, title_arg = mock_task.delay.call_args[0]
    assert "alice" in email_arg
    assert title_arg == "task"


def test_status_change_to_non_completed_does_not_trigger_notification(auth_client):
    c, headers = auth_client
    created = create(c, headers, "task").get_json()
    with patch("app.send_notification_email") as mock_task:
        resp = c.put(
            f"/tasks/{created['id']}", json={"status": "in_progress"}, headers=headers
        )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    mock_task.delay.assert_not_called()


def test_title_only_update_does_not_trigger_notification(auth_client):
    c, headers = auth_client
    created = create(c, headers, "task").get_json()
    with patch("app.send_notification_email") as mock_task:
        resp = c.put(
            f"/tasks/{created['id']}", json={"title": "new title"}, headers=headers
        )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    mock_task.delay.assert_not_called()


def test_already_completed_task_does_not_retrigger_notification(auth_client):
    c, headers = auth_client
    created = create(c, headers, "task").get_json()
    c.put(f"/tasks/{created['id']}", json={"status": "completed"}, headers=headers)

    with patch("app.send_notification_email") as mock_task:
        resp = c.put(
            f"/tasks/{created['id']}", json={"status": "completed"}, headers=headers
        )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    mock_task.delay.assert_not_called()


def test_notification_not_triggered_for_other_users_task(client):
    register(client, "alice", "password1")
    register(client, "bob", "password2")
    alice_headers = auth_headers(login(client, "alice", "password1").get_json()["token"])
    bob_headers = auth_headers(login(client, "bob", "password2").get_json()["token"])

    alice_task = create(client, alice_headers, "alice task").get_json()

    with patch("app.send_notification_email") as mock_task:
        resp = client.put(
            f"/tasks/{alice_task['id']}",
            json={"status": "completed"},
            headers=bob_headers,
        )
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    mock_task.delay.assert_not_called()


def test_notification_failure_does_not_break_response(auth_client):
    c, headers = auth_client
    created = create(c, headers, "task").get_json()
    with patch("app.send_notification_email") as mock_task:
        mock_task.delay.side_effect = Exception("broker unavailable")
        resp = c.put(
            f"/tasks/{created['id']}", json={"status": "completed"}, headers=headers
        )
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.get_json()
    assert body["status"] == "completed"
